sourceSentences: Hwei's damaging abilities mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. Subsequent damaging abilities against marked targets consume the mark to create an explosion beneath them
The ability that consumes the mark cannot apply it on the same cast instance.
The explosion occurs around the marked target from where they were when the ability damaged them to consume the mark.
The target who had their mark consumed is able to escape the area of the explosion within the delay period.
Hwei exits his current mood without incurring its ability cost or cooldown, toggling it off.
Wash Brush can only be cast if Hwei has entered a mood, and can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.
Spiraling Despair can only be cast if Hwei has not entered a mood.
Hwei calls upon a lightning bolt to strike at the target location after 1 second, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area.
If Severing Bolt hits only one enemy or immobilize enemies, it deals increased damage based on the target's missing health.
Hwei forms a current of water in the target direction, creating a path for a duration that grants him and allied champions bonus movement speed and ghosting
Hwei surrounds himself in swirling flares that empower his next 3 basic attacks or ability hits within 9 seconds to each deal bonus magic damage and restore mana.
After 0.7 seconds of being placed, the eye locks onto the nearest visible enemy champion or otherwise remains there until an enemy champion is in range.
Enemies that are not standing at the center when the jaw snaps are pulled there.
For combos, in lane use QE into EE to drag your opponent into the shockwave while you farm.
Your go-to is to WE into EQ into QQ then attack and ultimate to fear your opponent away and great damage.
And if escaping, start WQ into EW. And if your opponent gets caught out, use QW.
Hwei's passive is when he damages an enemy with two separate abilities, after a short delay, he creates an explosion underneath them dealing damage to all enemies hit.
Start with QE to force movement, then cast E to pull enemies back into the zone.
Start with EW to set a trap in force paths like jungle entrances, choke
QW is then placed on the snared enemy, layering guaranteed damage while they're locked down.
Place it into fog or brushes before you walk up.
EQ is your emergency button to fear the target chasing you. Once they're feared, R is guaranteed, locking them in place.
Enemies with dashes or blinks can escape the explosion.
Activate WE before trading. The empowered autos help you proc your passive faster and win short exchanges.
